review.seedPrompt: Fix the {{count}} quarantine causes in this book; rows that only wait on a cause clear with it. Page through all cases, gather the available evidence, and put every correction the evidence supports into one server-verified plan with reasons, so I confirm once. Make no unapproved changes. Afterwards, briefly list what still needs evidence or a decision from me.

evidence.label: Evidence needed

why.connect_wallet: Connecting the watch-only wallet lets the review check the actual movements.
why.import_history: The export can establish what happened before or after the visible transfer.
why.attach_evidence: The file will be saved as evidence for this transaction and made available for analysis. This does not import transactions or resolve the case.

evidence.stale: This request belongs to an earlier book or case state. Inspect the case again.
evidence.failed: The evidence could not be provided.

status.received: Received. Ready to check against the current book.
status.partial: Some changes were saved, but setup or sync did not finish. Continue to check what is available.
status.continuing: Provided. See the follow-up review below; supplying evidence does not settle the case.
status.stale: This request belongs to an earlier book or conversation.
status.unavailable: The gap remains acknowledged. Continue to consider other evidence.

outcome.received: The local setup or import finished; verify what data is now available.
outcome.partial: Some local changes were saved, but setup or sync did not finish. Inspect current data and the remaining blockers.
outcome.attached: The selected file was saved as evidence for this transaction and is available for analysis. No transaction history was imported; the case is not necessarily resolved.
outcome.unavailable: I do not have the requested evidence. Keep the gap explicit and consider alternative evidence.
outcome.attachedNotInChat: The selected file was saved as evidence for this transaction, but this chat already holds as many files as it can, so the file is not available for analysis here. No transaction history was imported; the case is not necessarily resolved.

evidence.attachedNotInChat: The file was saved as evidence on the transaction but not added to this chat. Remove a file, or start a new chat, to analyze it here.
evidence.continuePrompt: Continue the evidence review. {{outcome}} Inspect the current cases again before making a proposal. Cases: {{cases}}
evidence.sourceFundsContinuePrompt: Continue the source-of-funds review for the same target, amount and purpose. {{outcome}} Read the current source-of-funds review context and evidence again. Keep recorded provenance separate from accounting and request consent before changes. Cases: {{cases}}
evidence.importTargetHint: Use the connection whose history this export describes. Importing into an existing connection reuses that wallet.
evidence.attachmentUnverified: The file picker did not confirm that evidence was saved to the requested transaction.
